chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAbd Rabbih, who said:
I said to him: What do you say about a ring-stone made from the stones of Zamzam? He said: “There is no harm in it, but when he intends al-istinjāʾ, he should remove it.”

key_terms.الْفَصِّ: the stone or gem set in a ring
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no legal problem or objection in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wear a ring-stone made from the stones of Zamzam during al-istinjāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that using a ring-stone made from the stones of Zamzam is permissible. However, it instructs that it should be removed when a person intends al-istinjāʾ, reflecting reverence for what is connected to Zamzam and proper etiquette in matters of ritual purity.
